3. **Khả năng lập trình**: Claude 3.5 Sonnet có khả năng giải quyết 64% các vấn đề trong một bài kiểm tra lập trình, cao hơn nhiều so với 38% của Claude 3 Opus. Nó có thể viết, chỉnh sửa và thực thi mã với khả năng lý luận và xử lý sự cố tinh vi.

### 01Frontier intelligence at 2x the speed

- UpdateAug 28, 2025



### Consumer Terms and Privacy Policy


Today, we’re launching Claude 3.5 Sonnet—our first release in the forthcoming Claude 3.5 model family. Claude 3.5 Sonnet raises the industry bar for intelligence, outperforming competitor models and Claude 3 Opus on a wide range of evaluations, with the speed and cost of our mid-tier model, Claude 3 Sonnet.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet is now available for free on Claude.ai and the Claude iOS app, while Claude Pro and Team plan subscribers can access it with significantly higher rate limits. It is also available via the Anthropic [API](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/home), [Amazon Bedrock](https://aws.amazon.com/blogs/aws/anthropics-claude-3-5-sonnet-model-now-available-in-amazon-bedrock-the-most-intelligent-claude-model-yet/), and [Google Cloud’s Vertex AI](https://cloud.google.com/blog/products/ai-machine-learning/announcing-anthropics-claude-3-5-sonnet-on-vertex-ai-providing-more-choice-for-enterprises). The model costs $3 per million input tokens and $15 per million output tokens, with a 200K token context window.

![Claude model family](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2F1f044104447e9db6b22db3a06e45d114f50f274e-2200x1174.png&w=3840&q=75)

## Frontier intelligence at 2x the speed

Claude 3.5 Sonnet sets new industry benchmarks for graduate-level reasoning (GPQA), undergraduate-level knowledge (MMLU), and coding proficiency (HumanEval). It shows marked improvement in grasping nuance, humor, and complex instructions, and is exceptional at writing high-quality content with a natural, relatable tone.

Claude 3.5 Sonnet operates at twice the speed of Claude 3 Opus. This performance boost, combined with cost-effective pricing, makes Claude 3.5 Sonnet ideal for complex tasks such as context-sensitive customer support and orchestrating multi-step workflows.

In an [internal agentic coding evaluation](https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/fed9cc193a14b84131812372d8d5857f8f304c52/Model_Card_Claude_3_Addendum.pdf), Claude 3.5 Sonnet solved 64% of problems, outperforming Claude 3 Opus which solved 38%. Our evaluation tests the model’s ability to fix a bug or add functionality to an open source codebase, given a natural language description of the desired improvement. When instructed and [provided with the relevant tools](https://www.anthropic.com/news/tool-use-ga), Claude 3.5 Sonnet can independently write, edit, and execute code with sophisticated reasoning and troubleshooting capabilities. It handles code translations with ease, making it particularly effective for updating legacy applications and migrating codebases.

![Claude 3.5 Sonnet benchmarks](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2Fcf2c754458e9102b7334731fb18a965bfeb7ad08-2200x1894.png&w=3840&q=75)

## State-of-the-art vision

Claude 3.5 Sonnet is our strongest vision model yet, surpassing Claude 3 Opus on standard vision benchmarks. These step-change improvements are most noticeable for tasks that require visual reasoning, like interpreting charts and graphs. Claude 3.5 Sonnet can also accurately transcribe text from imperfect images—a core capability for retail, logistics, and financial services, where AI may glean more insights from an image, graphic or illustration than from text alone.

![Video thumbnail](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fimg.youtube.com%2Fvi%2FdhxrHvgXpSM%2Fmaxresdefault.jpg&w=3840&q=75)

![Claude 3.5 Sonnet vision evals](https://www.anthropic.com/_next/image?url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww-cdn.anthropic.com%2Fimages%2F4zrzovbb%2Fwebsite%2Fcaff3d60763b27b59fe33e4ae984530f0dba4ddb-2200x1110.png&w=3840&q=75)

turns.user: Tin tức AI hôm nay có gì nổi bật?
turns.assistant_text:
Dưới đây là một số tin tức nổi bật về AI hôm nay:

1. **Agentic AI Raises New Questions for Financial Institutions**  
   AI không chỉ dừng lại ở việc trả lời câu hỏi và tạo nội dung, mà còn đang được thiết kế để hành động. Agentic AI có khả năng theo đuổi mục tiêu, đưa ra quyết định và thực hiện hành động thay mặt cho người dùng, điều này tạo ra những thách thức mới về danh tính và quyền hạn trong các giao dịch tài chính. [Đọc thêm](https://www.wilmerhale.com/en/insights/client-alerts/20261110-agentic-ai-raises-new-questions-for-financial-institutions).

2. **Helping caregivers use AI in everyday life**  
   OpenAI đang hợp tác với các tổ chức cộng đồng để giúp các nhân viên chăm sóc xây dựng kỹ năng và sự tự tin trong việc sử dụng AI, nhằm giảm bớt thời gian tổ chức và tìm kiếm thông tin, từ đó tập trung hơn vào những người họ chăm sóc. [Đọc thêm](https://openai.com/index/helping-caregivers-use-ai-in-everyday-life).

3. **IBM and Microsoft announce a new AI agent platform designed for industry-specific transformation**  
   IBM và Microsoft đã công bố một nền tảng AI mới nhằm giúp các tổ chức kết hợp giữa chuyên môn con người và lao động kỹ thuật số, biến AI thành một lợi thế cạnh tranh thực sự. [Đọc thêm](https://news.microsoft.com/source/2026/11/10/ibm-and-microsoft-announce-a-new-ai-agent-platform-designed-for-industry-specific-transformation).

4. **Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips**  
   Google đã giới thiệu hai biến thể mới của các đơn vị xử lý tensor (TPUs) được phát triển nội bộ, nhằm mở rộng danh mục chip AI của mình và giảm sự phụ thuộc vào các nhà sản xuất chip khác. [Đọc thêm](https://techcrunch.com/2026/11/10/google-broadens-its-ai-hardware-portfolio-with-two-new-specialized-chips).

5. **Carson faculty discuss building AI literacy on Adobe podcast**  
   Các giảng viên tại WSU sẽ thảo luận về việc xây dựng khả năng hiểu biết về AI cho sinh viên trong một podcast của Adobe, nhằm chuẩn bị cho sinh viên không chỉ sử dụng AI mà còn hiểu rõ về nó. [Đọc thêm](https://news.wsu.edu/news/2026/11/10/nov-18-carson-faculty-discuss-building-ai-literacy-on-adobe-podcast).

Nếu bạn cần thêm thông tin chi tiết về bất kỳ tin tức nào, hãy cho tôi biết!

items.title: Agentic AI Raises New Questions for Financial Institutions
items.summary:
DownloadDownload

Artificial intelligence (AI) has moved beyond answering questions and generating content. Increasingly, AI systems are being designed to act. Agentic AI can pursue objectives, make decisions and take actions on a user’s behalf, potentially with limited human involvement in individual decisions. [...] Consider a customer who gives an AI agent access to a bank account with an instruction to manage the customer’s cash efficiently. The agent decides to transfer funds, convert currencies or purchase an investment.

At first sight, these may appear to be ordinary customer transactions. Agentic AI, however, exposes important distinctions between identity, authentication, authority and attribution. [...] As agentic AI becomes more capable, firms may increasingly encounter interactions in which an AI agent collects information, compares products and initiates transactions for a customer. That creates a new layer between the institution and the person or entity with whom it has established a customer relationship.

This National Family Caregivers Month, we’re proud to join OpenAI Academy, the Alzheimer’s Association and the American Diabetes [...] The AI Skills Jam is part of OpenAI Academy’s broader work to make AI practical and accessible to everyone. It builds on previous events we’ve hosted with nonprofits, small businesses, K–12 educators, and older adults.

items.title: IBM and Microsoft announce a new AI agent platform designed for industry-specific transformation - Source
items.summary: “Clients are no longer looking for AI that simply helps people do the same work a little faster. They want to build an agentic business,” said Mohamad Ali, Senior Vice President and Head of IBM Consulting. “Microsoft and IBM are helping organizations bring human expertise and digital labor together in a way that can scale across the enterprise, to turn AI from a productivity aid into a real competitive advantage.” [...] “AI is evolving quickly, and our focus at SEI is on applying it with intention in ways that strengthen trust, enhance human decision-making and create meaningful value across our business,” said Sneha Shah, Chief AI Strategist and Head of SEI Next. “Our work with IBM Consulting and Microsoft is helping us explore how emerging capabilities could support critical processes and be responsibly scaled over time, with the goal to create better experiences for our employees and clients. By combining [...] “Enterprise AI will be won by organizations that can turn their data, industry expertise and AI into action,” said Rodrigo Kede Lima, President, Microsoft Frontier Company. “Together, Microsoft and IBM Consulting are bringing the best of our technology and expertise, to help customers move from AI ambition to business impact faster and with confidence.”

items.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips | TechCrunch
items.summary:
The chip launch comes as hyperscalers like Microsoft, Amazon, and even AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic are working on their own lines of AI-specific semiconductors and accompanying software in order to reduce their reliance on the dominance of Nvidia.

The news also comes at a particularly vulnerable moment for Nvidia, whose CEO Jensen Huang over the weekend admitted to having an affair with someone alleged to be a Chinese spy. [...] The chip also has a custom inferencing network that lets it run reasoning alongside training, so it can be used to distill and train small models on the fly. That ability, according to Google, could prove useful for cases where a company might want to train a model on its proprietary data without having to move the data between devices. [...] Google is notching up its chipmaking game as the company seeks to reduce its dependence on chips made by other companies for its cloud computing business. Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its tensor processing units (TPUs), in-house developed chips meant for AI workloads, that broaden its chip portfolio to additional use cases: confidential inference and more memory capacity for large workloads.

—Chris Lehane, OpenAI’s Chief Global Affairs Officer [...] > “The future of caregiving isn’t about replacing human connection with technology. It’s about using innovation to make care more manageable, accessible and connected. AI has real potential to help caregivers navigate information, coordinate responsibilities and reclaim valuable time, but only if we build their confidence and keep their needs at the center. This National Family Caregivers Month, we’re proud to join OpenAI Academy, the Alzheimer’s Association and the American Diabetes [...] The AI Skills Jam is part of OpenAI Academy’s broader work to make AI practical and accessible to everyone. It builds on previous events we’ve hosted with nonprofits, small businesses, K–12 educators, and older adults.

items.title: IBM and Microsoft announce a new AI agent platform designed for industry-specific transformation - Source
items.summary: “Clients are no longer looking for AI that simply helps people do the same work a little faster. They want to build an agentic business,” said Mohamad Ali, Senior Vice President and Head of IBM Consulting. “Microsoft and IBM are helping organizations bring human expertise and digital labor together in a way that can scale across the enterprise, to turn AI from a productivity aid into a real competitive advantage.” [...] “AI is evolving quickly, and our focus at SEI is on applying it with intention in ways that strengthen trust, enhance human decision-making and create meaningful value across our business,” said Sneha Shah, Chief AI Strategist and Head of SEI Next. “Our work with IBM Consulting and Microsoft is helping us explore how emerging capabilities could support critical processes and be responsibly scaled over time, with the goal to create better experiences for our employees and clients. By combining [...] “Enterprise AI will be won by organizations that can turn their data, industry expertise and AI into action,” said Rodrigo Kede Lima, President, Microsoft Frontier Company. “Together, Microsoft and IBM Consulting are bringing the best of our technology and expertise, to help customers move from AI ambition to business impact faster and with confidence.”

items.title: Google broadens its AI hardware portfolio with two new specialized chips | TechCrunch
items.summary:
The chip launch comes as hyperscalers like Microsoft, Amazon, and even AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic are working on their own lines of AI-specific semiconductors and accompanying software in order to reduce their reliance on the dominance of Nvidia.

The news also comes at a particularly vulnerable moment for Nvidia, whose CEO Jensen Huang over the weekend admitted to having an affair with someone alleged to be a Chinese spy. [...] The chip also has a custom inferencing network that lets it run reasoning alongside training, so it can be used to distill and train small models on the fly. That ability, according to Google, could prove useful for cases where a company might want to train a model on its proprietary data without having to move the data between devices. [...] Google is notching up its chipmaking game as the company seeks to reduce its dependence on chips made by other companies for its cloud computing business. Google on Monday unveiled two new variants of its tensor processing units (TPUs), in-house developed chips meant for AI workloads, that broaden its chip portfolio to additional use cases: confidential inference and more memory capacity for large workloads.
